newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire up on bid speculation.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire up on bid speculation.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Tyne-Tees Plc moved higher on Friday amid renewed rumours of a possible bid from Granada, traders said.
Yorkshire shares were 42-1/2p firmer at 12.85 stg by 1245 GMT.
"There are rumours floating about the market that Granada is going to come in and bid," one market-maker said. "But I don't see it happening for a while yet."
"There hasn't been much buying in the stock. I think the market is short,and it's a self-perpetuating motion," he added.
Rumours of a possible bid emerged in September last year, when Granada, which owns over 24 percent of Yorkshire, said it had an open mind regarding a full bid for the company.
The bid talk was spurred again last October by the introduction of more-relaxed cross-media ownership rules, which ended a two-licence limit on commercial television franchise control.
Granada shares were 16-1/2p lower at 913-1/2p by 1300 GMT.
